Create a NetworkComparison

Source: R/network-accessors.R
NetworkComparison.Rd

Builds a NetworkComparison from edge tables. Most users obtain one from run_comparative_network instead.

Usage

NetworkComparison(
  diff_edges = S4Vectors::DataFrame(),
  shared_edges = S4Vectors::DataFrame(),
  celltype_specific = list(),
  summary = list()
)

Arguments

diff_edges, shared_edges

DataFrames with one row per edge and at least the columns node_i and node_j. plot_network_comparison() also uses category and max_diff. Edges in shared_edges have category "shared".

celltype_specific

Named list of DataFrames, one per cell type, with the edges found only in that cell type.

summary

List with, for example, celltypes (the compared cell types), n_edges (named edge counts) and jaccard (named pairwise overlaps).

Value

A valid NetworkComparison.

See also

network-accessors

Examples

shared <- S4Vectors::DataFrame(node_i = "G1", node_j = "M1",
    category = "shared", max_diff = 0.1)
differential <- S4Vectors::DataFrame(node_i = "G2", node_j = "M1",
    category = "differential", max_diff = 0.5)
NetworkComparison(
    diff_edges = differential,
    shared_edges = shared,
    summary = list(celltypes = c("Monocyte", "B cell")))
#> NetworkComparison
#>   Cell types compared: Monocyte, B cell
#>   Shared edges: 1
#>   Differential edges: 1
